tasks.DefineProblem: Define the problem using a recurrence relation or direct formula for counting ways to climb stairs with one or two steps at a time.
tasks.SolveRecurrenceRelation: Use the defined recurrence relation to find the number of ways to reach 10 steps.

answer: The number of ways a boy can reach the top of stairs which contain 10 steps, when he can take either one or two steps every time is 89.
